landing.name: I'm Gemma,
landing.body: Software Engineer with 3 years of professional development experience, having progressed from customer support into full-stack development at Easy Crypto. Experienced across Vue and React frontends, PHP and Node.js backends, and third-party service integrations.
landing.subBody: I enjoy building practical, reliable solutions and have a strong understanding of both technical and customer perspectives.
